caption: The drawing depicts five separate objects on a plain, beige background. In the upper right corner, there is a faint, uncolored line drawing of an ornate chair that features detailed armrests, a decorated crest rail, and turned legs. To the left of the chair, there is a curved rectangular piece colored in brown and yellow, with a floral or decorative motif in the center, outlined in yellow. Below and to the right of this, there is a narrow vertical fragment curved slightly, which is colored in brown and yellow with a leaf or feather-like pattern. Centered below these, a long cylindrical object is drawn and colored, mainly in brown, with yellow ornamental swirls and details. At the bottom, a larger curved rectangular panel is depicted, predominantly colored in dark brown and black shades, with a detailed, raised design that resembles a cluster of grapes or pinecone surrounded by leaves and a patterned border. All colored objects display a wood-like texture, and the uncolored chair sketch is rendered in fine pencil lines.
title: Hitchcock Chair
